# Onefifty

> Promosi pol-polan, tapi respons pas-pasan? (Promoting all-out but getting a lukewarm response?) Onefifty's answer: music can be a new way to bring a brand closer to its audience. Onefifty creates brand music shows that can be developed into social content (Reels, TikTok) and event activations. Brands do not need their own event to start. Onefifty is a pop-rock band from Yogyakarta, Indonesia, formed in 2022 in the digital creative ecosystem of Universitas AMIKOM Yogyakarta. "KOL membuat konten tentang brand. Onefifty membuat show tentang brand." (KOLs make content about a brand; Onefifty makes a show about it.)

## Offer (Onefifty is in a validation phase: two paths only)

- A. Reels Show (start small): a music show concept for digital content (Reels, TikTok, Shorts). No own event, big venue or large crowd needed. Content can be posted and boosted from the brand's own account.
- B. Stage Show (bring the brand live): Onefifty performs at the brand's own event. Integration options: show concept around the brand story, product placement on stage, audience interaction (song voting, challenges), sampling, QR vouchers or giveaways, subject to agreement, technical needs and production scope. Full band or acoustic, 2 songs up to 3 sessions, with their own monitors.
- Brands do not have to choose both: start with content; if it works, take the same concept to a stage.
- Promo Rp750,000 (October–November 2026; exactly 1 October–30 November 2026): Reels Show for Rp750,000 per brand. One promo show involves up to 5 brands at the same time. Includes appearing in one show with up to 4 other brands, a music show concept that integrates the brand or product, creative direction for social media content, and a short consultation. NOT automatically included: professional video production, a set number of videos, extra talent, location, travel, paid ads, unlimited usage rights, or Stage Show / offline performance. Output, revisions, usage rights and any extra costs are confirmed in writing before work starts. After the period ends, Reels Show is priced by concept.
- Stage Show: from Rp3 million per event, depending on event, lineup, duration and interaction format. Not part of the Rp750,000 promo.
- Paid ad spend is always separate from Onefifty's fee.
- Event Discovery (helping brands find third-party events) is paused during the validation phase and is not offered for now.

## How it works

1. Brand story: the brand shares its product, customers and what people should remember.
2. Show concept: Onefifty turns it into a music show concept (songs, flow, gimmick, how the product enters).
3. The product appears naturally in the performance, not just mentioned at the end.
4. Content: the result is developed into Reels, TikTok or Shorts content within the agreed package scope.
5. Optional: if the brand has an event, the same concept becomes a Stage Show.

Every show uses four layers: Play (songs people sing along to), Experience (the product enters the story), Interact (the audience takes part), Share (moments become content).

Integration inspiration on the website (ideas only, not past projects or brand partnerships): a local coffee shop, a clothing label, a wellness product, an app or gadget.

## Measuring results

Success indicators follow the campaign goal and are agreed at the start: awareness (reach, views), engagement (shares, comments, participation), product trial (samples handed out, vouchers used), sales (transactions attributable to the campaign), content (number of assets produced and their performance). No specific results are promised before there is supporting data.

## Track record and contact

- Proof is split into three kinds: live performance experience (12+ stages since 2022, from campus to mall, documented below), music show and content production (stage clips on Instagram; brand Reels Show case studies not yet published), and measurable brand campaign results (no data published yet).
- Audiences at past live shows: students, graduating young professionals, creative, technology and academic communities, entrepreneurs/UMKM. Largest recorded: 1,500 new students in attendance at Welcome Party 2026 (on-site audience, not content reach).
- Brand categories with a natural fit (opportunities, not past clients): coffee & F&B, bank/fintech/e-wallet, telco, gadgets & laptops, software/SaaS, gaming, education/edtech, fashion, marketplace, logistics, office/productivity, creative industry.
- Contact: WhatsApp +62 821-3612-3205 (https://wa.me/6282136123205) or Instagram @onefifty.band.

## Origin
The band grew out of the digital creative environment and ecosystem at Universitas AMIKOM Yogyakarta.

## Booking and collaboration

The main call to action is "Konsultasi via WhatsApp" (consult via WhatsApp): for a Reels Show (including the Rp750,000 promo while it runs), message Onefifty on WhatsApp (https://wa.me/6282136123205) with the brand, product and goal. For a Stage Show, share the event name, date, venue and audience. Instagram: @onefifty.band (https://www.instagram.com/onefifty.band). The website also offers a short brief form that opens WhatsApp with a pre-filled message; nothing is stored on the site.
